title: Infandous
author: Elana K. Arnold
current_text: In 2024, a Brevard County Schools committee voted to remove Infandous, and the board upheld that recommendation on May 28, removing the book.

sources.quote:
May 17, 2024
Committee meets on "Infandous" and "Not My Problem"
Votes to keep "Not My Problem" (3-1) and remove "Infandous" (3-1)
May 28, 2024
Board upholds committee recommendations, removing "Infandous" and keeping "Not My Problem"
